messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert (PD-8472) triggered for tenant 'helioscare' — dedicated reserved pool latency exceeded threshold. Alert link: https://pagerduty.com/alerts/PD-8472

pagerduty-bot: Incident auto-assigned to @sam (primary oncall). Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre.

sam: ack'd. I'm on it. pinging @anya in case we need infra help.

anya: on my way, looking at metrics now. which cluster?

sam: dedicated-prod-us-west-2 / reserved-pool: helioscare-reserved-01. p99 API latency jumped ~3.2x and queue depth at 98%. seeing 503s for some requests.

maria: customer (HeliosCare) is seeing errors on their ingest endpoint, support has opened a ticket. helioscare-sre is in the loop.

leo: looking at runtime logs — KV cache eviction spikes + a couple of OOMs on GPUs. One node showing repeated kernel panics which probably reduced effective capacity and cascaded queuing.

sam: runbook says: check reserved pool utilization, enable fallback routing, and scale reserved pool if needed. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-pool-latency

anya: pulling reserved-pool metrics -> query run:
```
ri-monitor query --cluster reserved/helioscare-reserved-01 --metric queue_depth,p99_latency,err_rate --since 5m
```

anya: results: queue_depth: 920 (normal <200), p99_latency: 1.2s (normal ~0.35s), err_rate: 8.7% (normal <0.5%).

maria: customer impact: roughly 5% of requests failing upstream, SLA at risk. They want updates every 10m.

sam: short mitigation plan: enable fallback to 'helioscare-variant-lite' and apply soft-throttle to shed low-priority traffic. I'll update routing now.

leo: routing change command:
```
rictl traffic-route update --tenant helioscare --route main --fallback helioscare-variant-lite --enable-soft-throttle
```

sam: executing... (10:04:12) -> api: 200 OK. Route updated, fallback is live.

pagerduty-bot: Note: route change recorded in incident log.

anya: also issuing emergency scale +2 nodes for the reserved pool:
```
rictl reserved scale --pool helioscare-reserved-01 --delta 2
```

anya: scale request submitted; new nodes provisioning (ETA ~6-8m). observed provisioning note: node-az3-07 failed with kernel panic and is being reprovisioned.

leo: I've applied a temporary quant profile to reduce memory pressure:
```
rictl model update --tenant helioscare --model main --quant-profile balanced
```

sam: monitoring results... p99 starting to drop.

(10:07:50) sam: p99=0.6s, queue=420, err_rate=3.2% — trending in the right direction but not baseline yet.

helioscare-sre: thanks, we see a drop on our side too. holding traffic and watching for 10m.

maria: opening customer-facing incident update with current mitigations and ETA for full recovery.

anya: action note: root cause hypothesis = transient node OOM -> KV cache evictions -> request thrash -> queue saturation. will keep an eye on kernel panic recurrence.

sam: if not stable in 15m, we'll escalate to infra oncall and consider failing over to a secondary reserved pool.

sam: setting PD escalation timer for 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: linking logs/traces: https://redwood.internal/traces/trace/abcd1234

leo: adding incident note: applied fallback routing, quant profile change, scaled +2 nodes.

incident-bot: Incident PD-8472 acknowledged by sam at 2026-03-14T10:03:12Z. Status: mitigated -> stabilizing. Will monitor until 2026-03-14T10:25:00Z.

sam: handing off monitoring to @anya for the next 30m; I need to step off pager in ~10m. please escalate if errors rebound.

anya: taking watch. will monitor node provisioning and tail kernel logs for az3. will post updates every 5m or on state change.

helioscare-sre: appreciated. we'll prepare to fail traffic to our fallback endpoint if necessary.

sam: wrapping up — documented actions in runbook and incident log. :white_check_mark:
